title: Steely
summary: STEELY, adjective 1. Made of steel; consisting of steel. Broachd with the steely point of Cliffords lance. Around his shop the steely sparkles flew. 2. Hard; firm. That she would unarm her noble heart

inlines.v: STEELY, adjective 1. Made of steel; consisting of steel. Broachd with the steely point of Cliffords lance. Around his shop the steely sparkles flew. 2. Hard; firm. That she would unarm her noble heart of that steely resistance against the sweet blows of love.
